turns.text: Hey! Sorry I've been slow to reply this week. I'm covering extra night shifts at Mission, so my days are kind of a blur. Are you still up for the river cleanup Saturday?

Hey! No worries, I know night shifts eat your week. Yeah, I'm still in for Saturday. I'm buried in a set of oak chairs for a client who wants them before Thanksgiving, so I might be a bit grumpy and covered in stain, but I'll be there. What time are you thinking, and do you want to meet at the put-in or carpool from somewhere?
Ha, covered in stain sounds about right. Good luck with the chairs, and don't rush them on my account.
Thanks, Maya. I'll try not to rush them, though the client's already asked twice. Really glad you're still up for Saturday. Want to meet at the put-in at 9, or should I grab you on the way?

For Saturday, I'm off the night shift that weekend, so I could be there by 8:30 if the cleanup starts at 9. I'd rather meet at the put-in than carpool. I'm not sure I'll be awake enough to drive anyone around after a week of this. Does that work for you, or is the cleanup starting earlier?

Works for me. Meeting at the put-in makes sense, and I'd rather you not drive after a week like this anyway. I'll be there by 8:30 too. I don't think the cleanup starts earlier, but I'll double-check the group's schedule tonight so we don't miss the check-in.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Sounds good, Tom. Meet at the put-in at 8:30, and thanks for checking the schedule. I still need to call my coworker about the rest of the week, so I'll see if I can get that done today before my shift tonight.
Sounds good, Maya. Put-in at 8:30 Saturday. Good luck with the call and with getting some sleep before tonight's shift.
One thing I still need to sort out is the exact put-in spot, since I didn't get to it Sunday. I'll message you once I've confirmed it.
Thanks, Tom. Let me know the exact spot once you've confirmed it. I'll be there at 8:30.
Will do, Maya. I'll confirm the put-in spot and message you as soon as I have it. See you Saturday at 8:30.
Sounds good, Tom. See you Saturday at 8:30.
Sounds good, Maya. See you Saturday at 8:30.

brief: This is a chat on your phone with Maya. You matched on a dating app last week and have been texting since. You both live in Duluth, Minnesota, and met on a dating app last week after realizing you're both regulars at the same Lakewalk coffee cart.

privateLines.Maya: You work the overnight desk at the Duluth harbor's Coast Guard station, logging ship traffic through a sleet-heavy November, and you're spending your days off repainting the sunporch of the duplex you just moved into.
privateLines.Tom: You're a second-year nurse on the cardiac floor at St. Luke's, pulling three twelve-hour shifts this week, and your mother has been calling every evening about whether you'll come home to Cloquet for Thanksgiving.

turns.text: Hey! Sorry for the slow reply, I've been up to my elbows in primer on the sunporch all afternoon. Still can't tell if the color I picked is "sage" or just "sad green." How's your Sunday going?
Ha, "sad green" is a real risk with sunporch paint. Send me a photo once it dries and I'll give you an honest verdict.

My Sunday's been pretty quiet. I'm getting ready for three twelve-hour shifts this week, so I'm mostly doing laundry and trying to sleep early. My mom also calls every evening to ask if I'm coming home to Cloquet for Thanksgiving. I haven't given her an answer yet.
Did you get the primer on the trim too, or just the walls?

Yeah, I did the trim too, so my hands and my hair both smell like primer. Three twelve-hour shifts sounds brutal, so get your sleep. Sorry your mom is pressing about Thanksgiving. Are you leaning toward Cloquet, or still weighing it?
Primer hair is a rough look. Hope you have a good shampoo situation.

Honestly, I'm still weighing it. Part of me wants to go home and not have to think about it. The other part knows that if I'm working the Wednesday before, I might not be able to get the time off, and I don't want to lie to her or promise something I can't do. I'll probably call her tomorrow once I know what my schedule looks like.
What about you? Are you going anywhere for Thanksgiving, or staying in Duluth?

Ha, I've got a double shampoo lined up. Thanksgiving is still open for me too. I'm on the overnight desk at the station, so I'll check whether I'm on the schedule, and if I'm off I'll probably stay in Duluth. My family's spread out, so it's usually a quiet day for me. Hope the call with your mom goes okay tomorrow. Do you think you'll be able to make it home if your schedule allows?

If my schedule allows it, yeah, I think I'd want to go. Cloquet is only about 30 minutes up the road, so it's not a big trip. The hard part is that I'd have to get the day off, and I don't know yet if I can.
A quiet Thanksgiving in Duluth sounds kind of nice, honestly. Especially after a week of twelve-hour shifts. Good luck with the schedule check.

Thanks, I'll take the good luck. Cloquet being thirty minutes away makes it sound more doable than it feels right now. I hope the schedule comes through so you can see your family. And if I end up with a quiet Thanksgiving, I'm not opposed to coffee at the cart, or some leftovers, or just a walk on the Lakewalk.
Coffee at the cart or a walk on the Lakewalk sounds good to me. I'd like that a lot.
Let's figure out the Thanksgiving plans once you know your schedule and I know mine. For now, I'm going to get some sleep before my first shift. Good luck with the sunporch, and send me that photo.

Sounds good. I'm glad you'd like that too. Get some sleep before your first shift, and good luck with the twelve hours. I'll send the sunporch photo once the paint dries and I've had a chance to forgive myself for the color. Talk soon, Tom.
Ha, I'll look forward to that verdict. Night, Maya. Talk soon.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Night, Tom. Good luck with the shift, and I hope the sleet holds off on the drive.
Thanks, Maya. Hope the sleet stays away, and good luck with the sunporch today.
Thanks, Tom. The sunporch is getting a second coat today, so wish me luck with that too. Hope your shift is quiet.
Good luck with the second coat. Hope the sage holds up.
Heading in now. Thanks for the wishes, and I'll text you later.
Ha, I'll take sage if it holds. Have a good shift, Tom. Text me when you get a break.
Will do, Maya. I'll text you on my break.
Sounds good, Tom. I'll be up to my elbows in paint, but I'll check my phone.
Ha, hope the paint cooperates. I'll text you on break.
Ha, I'll take that. Talk to you on your break, Tom.
Sounds good, Maya. Talk later.
Talk later, Tom.
Later, Maya.

brief: This is a chat on your phone with Maya. You matched on a dating app last week and have been texting since. You both live in Duluth, Minnesota, and met on a dating app last week after realizing you're both regulars at the same Lakewalk coffee cart.

privateLines.Maya: You work the overnight desk at the Duluth harbor's Coast Guard station, logging ship traffic through a sleet-heavy November, and you're spending your days off repainting the sunporch of the duplex you just moved into.

turns.text: Hey Tom! Sorry, I've been up to my elbows in sunporch paint all day. Thought I'd check in before my shift tonight. Did you ever make it to the Lakewalk cart this week, or has the sleet kept you indoors too?
Hey! Sunporch paint sounds like a big project. Did you finish it or is it a two-day job?

I didn't make it to the cart this week. I've had three twelve-hour shifts on the cardiac floor, and by the time I got off, the sleet had me walking straight to my car. I'm hoping for a warmer morning before the week's over, though. Is the cart still open this late in November, or did they pack up?
Hi Tom! It's a two-day job, at least. I finished the trim and one wall, and the other three are still waiting on me. My arms are not thrilled about it.
Three twelve-hour shifts on the cardiac floor sounds exhausting. Hope you get a real day off soon.

As for the cart, I think they're still out there through the end of November, weather permitting. I'm not sure about this week, though, since the sleet has been bad. I'd check before you make the trip. If you're up for it, we could try for Thursday morning. I start my overnight shift at the Coast Guard station that evening, so I'd be sleepy but awake enough for coffee.
Ha, two days of paint will do that to your arms. Hope the other three walls go faster than you expect.

Thursday morning sounds good to me. I'm off Thursday, so I can meet you whenever works for you. If the sleet's bad I'll check the cart's socials before we go. Want to aim for 8 so you can still get some sleep before your shift?
Thursday at 8 works! I'll probably be a little bleary, but I'd rather see you than sleep an extra hour, so it's a deal.
Deal. I'll bring the bleary energy too. Those twelve-hour shifts have made me a pro at running on coffee.
Thanks for checking the cart's socials. I'll do the same. If the sleet gets bad, we can switch to a different day without it being a big deal.
I'll be at the cart by 8, so look for the guy in the gray Carhartt. I'll text you when I'm there, and if the sleet ruins the plan, we can pick a new day.
Good luck with the other three walls, too. I'm trying not to think about how many more coats they need.
Ha, I'll hold you to that coffee energy. Gray Carhartt, got it. I'll be the one with paint on my sleeves and no sleep.
Text me when you're there, and if the weather turns, we'll figure out a new day. Good luck with your shifts this week, and get some rest before Thursday!
Ha, paint on the sleeves is a good look. I'll be the one trying not to yawn.
Thanks for the good-luck wishes. I'll try to get some rest before Thursday. Text me if the weather changes and I'll do the same. See you at the cart.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Sounds good, Tom! See you at the cart Thursday at 8. Gray Carhartt, paint on my sleeves, and hopefully the sleet stays away.
Sounds good, Maya. Gray Carhartt, and I'll keep an eye on the sleet. Hope your Monday's gentler than it sounds with that paint.
Thanks, Tom! Mine's a quiet one, probably mostly sleep before the shift tonight. See you Thursday.
Sleep sounds like the right call. See you Thursday, Maya.
Night, Tom. See you Thursday!
Night, Maya. See you Thursday!
Ha, it's actually morning for me, but I'll take the sentiment. Sleep well, Tom. Thursday at 8!
Ha, fair, my "night" was backwards. Thanks, Maya. Thursday at 8, and I'll try to get some sleep before then.
Ha, sleep well, Tom! Thursday at 8, gray Carhartt, and I'll be the one with paint on her sleeves.
Sounds good, Maya. Gray Carhartt, Thursday at 8. See you then.
See you Thursday, Tom!
See you Thursday, Maya!

turns.text: Hey both. Sunday evening, so I'm wiped from the run of nights, but I've been thinking about Mum's 60th next month and nobody's planned anything yet. Shall we do something? Could we decide who's doing what this week?

Yes, let's do something. Sorry, Maya, I know you've been on nights. I'm flat out this week with a big bid for a care home refurb, so I can't take on much. I can cover the cost of a sensible venue or the cake, or chip in on whatever you two sort out. Jo, are you free to look at venues or ring round for a date? Maya, if you can text the family WhatsApp about the date, that'd help too.

Yes, I can look at venues. This week is nativity rehearsals plus helping with the flat move, so I'll do the searching in the evenings and ring round at the weekend. Maya, could you pick a date that suits you after nights? Once we have a date I'll shortlist a few places near Mum and Dad's and send them to the group. Tom, I'll keep the cake and venue costs in mind when I compare them.
Thanks both. Tom, I appreciate you covering costs. Jo, that split works.

For the date, I'm on nights most of this week and rest up the days after, so a weekend in late December is easiest for me. Saturday 12th or Saturday 19th? Mum's birthday itself is Friday 11th, so either is fine for a party. I'll check my rota for the 12th tonight and let you know. Once you two have a few venues shortlisted, I'll post the date in the family WhatsApp so Mum and Dad don't find out by accident.

Saturday 12th sounds good to me, since it's the weekend after her birthday and it keeps the 19th as a backup. I'll start searching for venues tonight. Christmas parties book up fast in December, so I'll check availability for both dates and send a shortlist to the group by Wednesday. Maya, once you've confirmed your rota, post the date in the family WhatsApp.
Sounds good, Jo. Saturday 12th it is, pending my rota. I'll check it tonight and confirm here. Then I'll post the date in the family WhatsApp.
Brilliant, thanks Maya. I'll get the venue search going tonight and keep the 12th as the working date until you confirm.
I'll check my rota now and confirm here shortly.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Sorry, I fell asleep on the sofa last night before I got to the rota, so I haven't checked it yet. My manager hasn't replied to my request for the 12th off either. I'll look at the rota as soon as I'm up properly and tell you both by this evening whether the 12th works. If it doesn't, we can go with the 19th.

Thanks Maya, no worries at all. Get some rest first. I'll keep looking at venues for both the 12th and the 19th, so whichever date you confirm, we'll have options ready. If the 12th falls through, I'll switch to the 19th straight away.

Thanks both. Maya, don't worry, get some sleep. Jo, that's a sensible plan to keep both dates open. I'm on a callout in Ripon this morning, so I'll be slow to reply, but I'll ring the cake place once I'm back at the kitchen table.
Thanks Tom, sounds good. I'll keep the venue search going and let you know what I find.
Thanks both, that's really kind. I'm going to sleep now and I'll check the rota when I wake up. I'll confirm the date here by this evening.
Sleep well, Maya. I'll keep looking at venues for both dates and send a shortlist to the group once I've got some options.
(It's now Wed 25 Nov.)

Morning. I owe you a shortlist, and I don't have one yet. I've been pushing the venue calls back all week, so I'll ring the places near Mum and Dad's tonight and send you what I've got before the end of the day. Maya, have you heard back about the 12th? If it's still open, I'll ask about both dates when I ring.

Morning Jo. Honest answer: I haven't heard back, and I still haven't checked the rota. I've been putting it off, which isn't fair to you two. I'll chase my manager today and confirm here by this evening. Yes, please ask about both dates when you ring.
Thanks for being straight about it, Maya. We're all behind on this, so let's just get it moving. I'll ring tonight and ask about both dates, and I'll send the group what I find as soon as I have it.
Thanks Jo. I'll message my manager now and check the rota on my break, then confirm here.
Sounds good, Maya. I'll ring round tonight and send the group whatever I find.
Thanks Jo. I'll get onto my manager now.

We're all behind on this, me included. I still haven't rung the cake place, and I'll be honest that I'm not sure I'll get round to it today with the bid on the table. I'll ring them tonight once I'm home, whatever the date ends up being, and tell you what they can do. Maya, if the 12th is clear by this evening, go ahead and post it in the family WhatsApp.
Thanks Tom, that's fair. I'll confirm the 12th or switch to the 19th here by this evening, and I'll post the date in the family WhatsApp once it's settled.
Thanks both. Tom, ringing the cake place tonight is a good plan. Maya, I'll ring the venues tonight for the 12th and the 19th, and I'll send the group what I find as soon as I have it.
Thanks Jo. I haven't heard from my manager yet and I still haven't checked the rota. I'll sort that out and confirm here this evening.
Thanks Maya. I'll ring the venues tonight, and I'll send the group whatever I find as soon as I have it.
Thanks Jo.

turns.text: Hey you two. I'm wiped from covering nights all week, but I've been thinking about Mum's 60th next month and we haven't planned anything yet. Could we pick a weekend and sort a plan? I'm free after my shifts finish on the 30th if that helps.

Happy to help sort this, Maya. Sorry you're running on nights. Since it's December, the weekends are the 5th–6th, 12th–13th and 19th–20th. The 12th–13th might clash with my school nativity prep, so I'd lean towards the 5th or 6th if you're both free. Tom, what do you think? And Maya, does a Saturday lunch at Mum and Dad's work, or would you rather go out somewhere?

Thanks Jo. The 5th or 6th works for me. I'm off nights by then, though I might be dead on my feet, so a Saturday lunch at Mum and Dad's sounds better than going out. Would Mum suspect something if we all turn up at once? Maybe we say it's a family lunch and surprise her with a cake. Tom, are you around on the 5th?

Yeah, a family lunch on the 5th is an easy cover story. Mum won't think twice about us all coming over, especially if we say it's just a catch-up. I'd say keep the cake a surprise, but maybe give Dad a heads-up so he can keep her from making other plans that day. I can pick up the cake on the way, if someone sorts the card and presents. Tom, are you in?

Sounds good, Jo. I'll ring Dad tonight and let him know the 5th is the plan, so he can keep Mum free. I can sort the card and a present. I'm thinking something from all three of us, maybe a framed photo from when we were kids? I'll look for one at home this week. Tom, can you chip in on the present too?
Yep, I'm in for the 5th. I'll get the card and presents sorted, and I'll give Dad a heads-up so he can keep Mum free that day.

Brilliant, thanks both. Maya's already got Dad covered, so Tom, you don't need to ring him too, though a quick text wouldn't hurt. I'll get the cake and sort the money for the framed photo. Maya, can you send me the total once you've got the frame, and I'll set up a transfer? Let's keep the cake a surprise until the day.
Yep, I'll chip in on the present. Maya, send me the frame total and I'll pay my share. I'll leave Dad to you two, so no need for me to ring him.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Morning both. Sounds like we're all set on the 5th. I'll sort the frame and send you the total once I've found the photo and priced a frame. I still need to ring Dad properly, since I didn't manage it last night, so I'll do that today after I've slept.
Morning. Sounds good, Maya. Send me the frame total when you have it and I'll pay my share.
Morning Tom. Will do. I'm heading to bed now after a rough night, so I'll look for the photo and get a price once I've slept.

Morning both. Sleep well, Maya, and don't worry about ringing Dad today if you're wiped. Tom, I'll hold off on the transfer until Maya sends the total. Once it's in, I'll sort my share and the cake. Ring Dad when you're up.
Morning. Will do, Jo. Thanks, Maya, get some sleep. I'll wait for the frame total.
Thanks Jo. I'll ring Dad when I'm up, and I'll send the frame total once I've found the photo.

Sounds good. Maya, once you've found the photo, just send me the total and I'll set up the transfer straight away. Jo's list for the week: order Mum's cake from a bakery and sort the costume list for the nativity.
Thanks Jo, will do. Night's sleep first, then the photo and total.
Sounds good, both. I'll wait for the total, Maya, and I'll pay my share once it's in.

Hi both. I slept most of the day, so I'm back on this. I'm still looking for the framed photo. I think it's at Mum and Dad's, so I'll check when I ring Dad tonight and send you the total once I've got a price.

Thanks Maya, that sounds like a plan. Ring Dad tonight and let us know what you find. Tom and I are both waiting on the total, so no rush beyond that. I'll keep an eye out for the cake order in the meantime.
Thanks Jo. I'll ring Dad tonight and let you know what I find.
Sounds good, Maya. Let us know what you find at Mum and Dad's. I'll pay my share once I have the total.
Will do, Tom. I'm about to start my shift, so I'll ring Dad after I finish and let you both know.
Good luck with the shift, Maya. Ring Dad when you finish and let us know.
Thanks Tom. I'll ring Dad once I'm off and let you both know what I find.
Sounds good, Maya. Thanks.
Good luck with the shift, Maya. Ring Dad when you're off and let us know what you find. Tom and I are waiting on the total, and I'll sort my share and the cake as soon as it's in.
Thanks Jo. I'm off shift now and I'm knackered, so I'll ring Dad tomorrow once I've slept and let you know what I find.
Fair enough, Maya. Get some sleep, and ring Dad when you're up.
Thanks Tom. Will do.
(It's now Tue 24 Nov.)
Morning both. Maya, sleep well, and ring Dad whenever you're up. Tom, nothing for you to do until the total's in. I'll sort the cake this week and set up my transfer once the frame price is in.
Morning Jo. Thanks. I'll pay my share once Maya sends the total.
Morning both. I'm still wiped, but I'll ring Dad today and check the loft for the photo, then send you the total.
Morning Maya. Thanks for sorting it. Send me the total when you've got it and I'll pay my share.
Morning Tom. Will do, once I've checked the loft and got a price for the frame.
Thanks, Maya. Ring Dad when you can. I'll wait for the total.
Will do, Tom. I'll ring Dad as soon as I'm up properly and let you know.
Morning both. Maya, no rush, sleep when you need to. Once the total's in, Tom and I will pay our shares. In the meantime I'll get the cake sorted this week.
Morning Jo. Sounds good. I'll pay my share once the total's in.
Morning both. I'm still behind on sleep, but I'll ring Dad and check the loft today and send you the total as soon as I have it.
Morning both. Maya, thanks for checking the loft. Once you've got the total, send it over and Tom and I will pay. I'll sort Mum's cake this week too.
Thanks both. Maya, send the total when you have it and I'll pay my share.
Morning both. I haven't checked the loft yet, so I don't have a total. I'll ring Dad and look for the photo as soon as I can and send the total then.
Thanks, Maya. No rush. Once you have the total, send it over and I'll pay my share.
Thanks both. Maya, no rush on the loft. Once you've got the total, send it over and I'll set up my share. I'm also still meaning to order Mum's cake, so I'll sort that today.
Thanks Jo. Maya, I'll pay my share once the total's in.
Thanks both. I'll ring Dad and check the loft today and send the total once I have it.
Thanks Tom. Maya, whenever you've had a chance to look in the loft, send the total over and we'll both sort our shares.
Jo, I'll also ring Dad about the 5th, since I haven't yet and I don't want to leave it to the other two.
Thanks Tom, that's helpful. I'll ring Dad too and check the loft today.
Thanks both. I'll ring Dad about the 5th today, and I'll pay my share once the total's in.
Thanks Tom, that's useful. Maya, let us know what you find in the loft when you can. I'm sorting Mum's cake this afternoon.
Thanks Jo. I haven't got to the loft yet. I'll ring Dad and check as soon as I'm up to it, and I'll send the total once I know.
Thanks Maya, no rush. Rest up when you can, and send the total once you've found the photo. I'll get Mum's cake sorted this afternoon.
Thanks both. Maya, rest up and send the total when you've found the photo. Jo, thanks for sorting the cake.
I still need to ring Dad about the 5th. I'll do it today.
Thanks Tom. Ring Dad when you can and let us know. I'll get the cake sorted this afternoon.

turns.text: Hiya both. I'm just up after a day's sleep, about to head into a night shift. Quick thing before I forget: Mum's 60th is next month and none of us has done anything about it yet. Can we sort something? I'm free on my day off Thursday, or I can do a group call this weekend if that's easier.

Hiya Maya, good shout. Thursday works for me if I can get my marking done by then. The weekend call is probably easier, though. I'm buried in field-trip reports and covering a class all week, so I'll be a zombie by Thursday. Sunday evening's best for me. Tom, are you free then?

Sunday evening's good for me too. I'll be on shift that night, so could we do it Sunday around 6? I'll be up and fed before I head in. Tom, does that work for you? If not, say so and we'll find another slot.
Sunday at 6 works for me, Maya. I'll have my reports marked by then, or at least I'll have stopped looking at spreadsheets. Tom, shout if that's a problem and we'll shuffle it.

Sunday 6 works for me. I'll be back from Carlisle by then. Shall one of us set up the call and send the link? And if we're doing a 60th, I'm happy to chip in on a present, so let's decide what we're getting her.

Brilliant, Sunday 6 it is. I'll set up the call and send the link tomorrow, so that's one thing off our list. On the present, Mum's always said she wants something she can use rather than more ornaments. I'll have a think about ideas this week and bring a few options to the call. Maya, if you can think of anything she's been dropping hints about, that'd help a lot.

Sounds good, Jo. Thanks for setting up the call. I'll think about what Mum's been hinting at. I'm not sure she's dropped any hints, but she did mention her kitchen radio giving up. Could be worth a look. Tom, if you can pitch in on a present, great. Let's aim to agree on the gift and a rough budget on Sunday so we're not still arguing about it at Christmas.

Ha, yes, let's not be still arguing about it at Christmas. A kitchen radio is a good shout, Maya. I'll look at a few options this week. Agreeing a rough budget on Sunday sounds sensible. I'll send the call link tomorrow.
Perfect, thanks Jo. I'll put Sunday 6pm in my diary and keep the radio idea in mind. I'm off to my shift now, so if anything comes up before then, message me and I'll reply when I'm back on a break.
Have a good shift, Maya. Thanks for sorting the radio idea. I'll message if anything changes before Sunday.
Thanks, Jo. Speak Sunday.
Speak Sunday, Maya. Good luck tonight.
Cheers, Jo. Night.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Night, Maya. Sleep well after the shift.
Thanks Jo. Just off shift now, heading to bed. Speak Sunday.
Sleep well, Maya. Speak Sunday.

turns.text: Hey, both of you around? Mum's 60th is next month and we haven't planned anything yet. I'm on nights at the clinic this week so I'm mostly awake in the afternoons, but I can do calls or group messages whenever suits. Any ideas? I was thinking a lunch at the Beaumont or something at home on Gilesgate Road, but I'm open.

Tom here, sorry, my phone's been in the van all day. Lunch at the Beaumont sounds good to me. Mum would hate a fuss at home anyway, and she'll have the house to herself to moan about afterwards. Friday evening's my drive back up, so a Saturday or Sunday lunch would work best for me. I'll check the dates with Dad and see if he's got any ideas. Are you two thinking of getting her anything in particular?

Good, that's the Beaumont then. Saturday or Sunday lunch works for me too, as long as it's not a night I'm working. I'll check my rota and send you the dates I can do. Thanks for checking with Dad, he'll know what Mum's got on.
For a present, I'm not sure yet. She's been on about wanting a proper pair of walking boots for the Cheviots, but I don't know if that's a bit too practical for a 60th. Jo, have you heard anything?

Walking boots sound like a good present to me, Maya. She'd actually use them, and you could add a card or a nice lunch to make it feel like a birthday. I'll ask Dad if she's already got a pair so we don't duplicate. I'll still ring him tomorrow about the dates, as I said.

Sounds good, Tom. Boots plus a card it is, pending Dad checking she hasn't already got a pair. I'll sort my rota tonight and send you the dates I can do before I go to bed. Jo, shout if you've got a different idea or want to split the cost of the lunch.
Sounds good, Maya. I'm happy to split the lunch cost. I'll wait for your dates and check mine against the marking deadline.
Thanks, Jo. Splitting the lunch three ways sounds fair. I'll send my dates shortly. Tom, once Dad's confirmed about the boots, let us know and we can settle on the day.
Will do, Maya. I'll ring Dad tomorrow evening and check on the boots and the dates, then post in the group. Three-way split on the lunch is fine by me.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Brilliant, thanks Tom. I'm on nights tonight, so I'll be in and out, but I'll look at the group whenever I surface. Once you've heard from Dad, post the dates and I'll confirm my rota against them.
Thanks, Maya. I'll check my marking deadline against whatever dates Tom posts and let you both know which ones work for me.
Sounds good, Jo. I'm just about to head into a shift, so I'll check the group again after I've surfaced tomorrow afternoon. Once Tom's got the dates from Dad, we can lock one in.
Morning both. I'm on site today with a pour running late, so I might not get to ring Dad until later on. I'll post the dates here as soon as I've spoken to him, and I'll check on the boots too.
Morning Tom, no rush. Hope the pour goes smoothly. I'm heading into my shift now, so I'll catch up on the group tomorrow afternoon once I've surfaced.
Thanks Maya, good luck on shift. I'll be on site until dark, so I'll ring Dad when I can and post in the group after.
Thanks Tom, I'll look out for your update tomorrow afternoon. Jo, let me know which dates suit you once Tom's posted them.
Will do, Maya. I'll check the marking deadline as soon as Tom posts the dates.
Thanks Jo. I'm mid-shift, so I'll check the group tomorrow afternoon.
(It's now Wed 25 Nov.)

Hi both, I still owe you my dates. I'm sorry this has dragged on, the field-trip marking swallowed my week. Tom, has Dad said anything yet about the boots or which Saturday works? Once I know, I'll check the calendar against my deadline and reply straight away.

Hi Jo, no worries. I haven't got through to Dad yet, the pours have kept me on site till dark all week and my phone's been in the van. I'm sorry this has dragged on. I'll ring him tonight and post the boots answer and the dates here as soon as I have them.
Hi both, no need to apologise. Tom, thanks for chasing Dad tonight. Jo, I'm sorry the marking has eaten your week.

I've been meaning to send my dates too. I'm on nights through the end of this week, so I can do any Saturday or Sunday lunch in the first half of December except the weekend of the 5th, when I'm on. I'll confirm the exact rota dates once they're out.
Also, I still need to ask Dad about the walking boots myself, so I'll do that after my shift tonight.

Thanks both. Maya, I can do the first half of December too, so I'll check the calendar and the marking deadline tonight and send you the Saturdays and Sundays that work for me, so we can line them up with Tom's dates.
Thanks Jo, that's helpful. Once you've sent yours and Tom's come through, we can pick the day that clashes with nobody. I'll be on nights, so I'll reply after I've surfaced.
Thanks both. I still haven't spoken to Dad, so I can't post the boots answer or dates yet. I'll ring him tonight and post here once I've got them.
I'm stuck at the kitchen table with the reports and the grade spreadsheet, and I haven't checked the calendar yet. I'll do it tonight and send my Saturdays and Sundays here as soon as I have them.

turns.text: Hiya both. Sorry I've gone quiet, I've been on nights all week and I'm running on about four hours' sleep. Has either of you thought anything about Mum's 60th? It's next month and I've realised nobody's planned a thing. I can't do much till my shifts ease off, but I could book somewhere for lunch if you two sort the rest?

Oh no, Maya, go and sleep! Yes, let's do lunch. I'll sort the rest. I've got the Thursday parents' evening and a pile of mocks, so I can't do much before then, but I can get some ideas together this week. Tom, are you around to help? Could you pull together a guest list from Mum's side? Happy to split it however suits you.

Thanks Jo, you're a star. Yes, I'll book lunch once I know roughly how many, so I'll wait on the list. Tom, you could split the guest list with Jo if that suits you? I'm off to try and sleep before my next run. Nights are brutal this week.

Sleep well, Maya. Tom, if you're happy to split the list, I'll take the cousins and the people from Mum's work, and you take the neighbours and church lot? I'll put a rough list in a doc once I've got a few names. Maya, I'll message you once we've got a headcount so you can book.
Sounds perfect, Jo. Thank you. Tom, let me know if the neighbours and church lot is too much and I can take a few. Night all.
Night, Maya. Sleep well.
Tom, no pressure. If the neighbours and church lot is too much, say so and I'll pick up what's left.

Cheers Jo, that's kind of you. I can manage the neighbours and church lot, but I'm flat out with the pew job until it's finished, so I'll have a proper go at it at the weekend. I'll send you whatever I've got by Saturday. If I'm behind, I'll shout.
Sounds good, Tom. Saturday works. I'll start my list this week and make a shared doc so we can both add names as we go. Let me know if you want me to take anything off your plate.

Brilliant, that's a solid plan. Jo, a shared doc is a great idea. Tom, Saturday's fine. I'm on nights again tomorrow, so I'll be properly useless until the weekend, but I'll look at the doc when I'm up. Once you've got a headcount, Jo, send it over and I'll book lunch.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Morning, Maya. The doc's already set up, so you can look whenever you're up. The work names are still blank, and I'm buried in mocks this week, so I'll fill them in once Thursday's parents' evening is out of the way. I'll send you a headcount as soon as I've got it.

Morning. Thanks Jo, that's helpful. I'm at the workshop again today, so I'll look at the doc tonight and add the neighbours and church names I've got. Might not be a full list by Saturday, but I'll get something across.
Thanks, Tom. Anything you can get across by Saturday helps, and we can fill gaps once Maya's booked. I'll keep an eye on the doc and add the work names when I can.
Will do. I'll get what I can across by Saturday.

Morning both. Thanks Jo, I'll have a look at the doc once I'm up this evening. Tom, anything you can get across by Saturday is great, and I'll sort the restaurant call as soon as there's a headcount. I'm on tonight, so if I'm slow to reply, that's why.
Got it, Maya. Once the work names are in I'll send you the headcount, so you can book as soon as it's ready. Hope the shift's not too rough.
Thanks Jo. Shift's been okay so far, just tired. I'll look at the doc later and ring the restaurant once you've got the numbers.
Glad it's been okay so far, Maya. Get some rest when you can. I'll send the numbers as soon as the work names are in.
Thanks Jo. Will do. Speak later.
Speak later, Maya.

turns.text: Hey you two, I know I'm rubbish at group chat, but Mum's 60th is next month and we haven't planned anything. I'm covering twelve-hour shifts all week so I'm no use for ringing around. Could one of you take the venue or restaurant and the other sort out a group card or present? I'll do the guest list and check Dad isn't secretly planning something already 😅

I'll take the card and present. I'm swamped with marking this week, but a card and a present are easy to sort from my phone. Tom, could you take the venue? Hexham has a few decent places, and you're probably closer to them if you're still up that way. Maya, if you can send the guest list when you get a chance, I'll pass the card round.

Sorry, Jo, I didn't see your message before I typed mine. I'll take the venue then. I can't ring places during the day, but I'll have a look at Hexham options tonight and make calls on my lunch break. Maya, send the guest list and rough numbers when you can. 🪚
Sounds good, Tom. Thanks for taking the venue. I'll start on the card and present this week and let you both know once I have ideas. Maya, if you spot anything Dad's planning, shout.

Brilliant, thanks both. Tom's on venue, Jo's on card and present, and I'll do the guest list. I'll get it to you once I've checked with Mum's sister and the neighbours. I'll sneak a look at Dad's texts too, though he's hopeless at keeping secrets. Shifts are brutal, so if I go quiet, assume I'm asleep. 😴
Sounds good, Maya. Get some sleep when you can. I'll look at venues tonight and ring round tomorrow at lunch, then let you both know what's available. 🪚
Thanks, Tom. Sounds like a plan. I'm on a run tonight so I'll be in and out, but I'll get the guest list to you both by Wednesday. 👍
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Thanks, Maya. Wednesday works. I'll keep an eye out for the guest list and get the card round for everyone to sign once I've picked a present.
Thanks Jo, that's great. I'm finishing a shift now and will try to ring the neighbours before handover so I can send the list. 👍
Good luck with the shift, Maya. Get some rest after, and I'll keep an eye out for the list on Wednesday.

Morning both. I've got venue duty, so I'll shortlist Hexham places on my lunch break and ring the two best ones. I'll update the group once I've spoken to them, probably this afternoon. Good luck with the shift, Maya. 🪚
Morning, Tom. Thanks for lining up the venues. Sounds like a good plan. I'll sort the card and present this week and let you both know what I come up with.
Thanks, Jo. Sounds good. I'll post an update on the venues this afternoon once I've rung the two best ones. 🪚
Thanks, Tom. Looking forward to hearing how the calls go.
Morning both, and thanks Tom and Jo. I'm still on shift until handover, so I'll reply properly once I'm off. Looking forward to hearing about the venues this afternoon. 👍
Morning, Maya. Good luck with handover, and get some sleep when you're off. I'll sort the card and present this week.
Morning both. Good luck with handover, Maya. I'll ring the two best Hexham venues at lunch and report back this afternoon. 🪚
Thanks, Tom. Looking forward to hearing how the calls go.
Thanks, Jo. I'll let you both know once I've rung them. 🪚
Sounds good, Tom. Thanks.

Thanks both, and sorry for the slow replies, I've been on shift. I'm off now and about to get some sleep, so I'll be quiet for a bit. I'll send the guest list on Wednesday as planned. Tom, let us know how the venue calls go. 🛌
Sleep well, Maya. Tom, looking forward to the venue update.
Thanks Jo, will do. Night, both. 😴
Night, Maya.
Sorry, I haven't had a chance to ring the venues yet. The pew job's been eating my days, so I'll call the two best Hexham places tomorrow lunchtime and report back then. 🪚
Thanks Tom, no worries. Tomorrow lunchtime works. I'm still catching up on sleep, so I'll be quiet until then. 👍
Thanks, Tom. Tomorrow lunchtime is fine. I'll keep working on the card and present, and I'll let you both know what I find.
(It's now Wed 25 Nov.)
Morning both. Wednesday's the deadline for the guest list, and I still haven't rung the neighbours. I'm on shift today, so I'll try to get it to you by this evening. 👍

Morning Maya. Don't stress about the list, we can work with what you've got tonight. I still owe you both the venue update. I'll ring the two Hexham places at lunch today and let you know what they say. 🪚
Morning both. Maya, don't worry about the list, send it when you can. Tom, thanks for ringing at lunch today. I'll get the card and present sorted this week, and I'll post once I've got a shortlist.

Morning Jo. I haven't rung anyone yet, so I owe you an apology: I said I'd ring at lunch on Monday and then again today, and I didn't. I'm behind because of the pew job and I haven't looked at the venues properly since Sunday. I'll be honest about what I can manage: I'll ring the two shortlisted places from the car park today, and if I can't reach them, I'll ask Jo or Maya to take over the venue so it doesn't slip further. 🪚

Thanks for being straight with us, Tom. No stress about it. Ring the two places from the car park today, and if either of them falls through, let me know and I'll take it on. I've still got the card and present to sort, so I'll keep going on those.
Thanks, Jo. I'll ring the two places from the car park at lunch and let you know. If either falls through, I'll hand it straight to you. 🪚
Sounds good, Tom. Thanks for being upfront about it.

Thanks both, and Tom, I appreciate you being straight about the venue. I'm still on shift and I haven't rung the neighbours, so I can't send the full list yet. I'll try to get it to you tonight once I'm off, even if some names are still missing. 👍
Thanks, Maya. Send whatever you have tonight, even if some names are missing. We can add the rest later. Good luck with the rest of the shift.
Thanks Jo, that's a relief. I'll send whatever I've got tonight, with the gaps marked. Good luck with marking. 👍
Thanks, Maya. Sounds good.

Thanks both. I'm at the bench until late, so I can't ring the venues today. I'll make it my first job tomorrow morning, and if either place falls through, I'll hand it straight to Jo. Maya, send whatever list you've got tonight, even if it's partial. 🪚
Thanks Tom, that's fine. I'll send whatever I've got tonight, with the gaps marked. Sorry I've been quiet, it's been a long run of shifts. 👍
Thanks both. Tom, tomorrow morning is fine, and if either place falls through, I'll take it on. Maya, no need to apologise, the shifts sound brutal. Send the list when you can.
Thanks Jo, that's kind. I'll send the list tonight once I'm off, gaps and all. 👍
Thanks, Maya. Get some rest after your shift, and don't worry about the gaps.
Thanks Jo, will do. Night shift's behind me, so I'll sleep first and send what I've got after. 😴
Sleep well, Maya. Send the list whenever you're up.

privateLines.Maya: You rent a flat in Easton with two flatmates and are juggling the lead on a packaging rebrand for a regional cheese company while your sister's wedding planning eats your evenings.

turns.text: Hey all, quick heads up: the cheese client has moved the packaging deadline up to Friday. I'm going to be working late this week, so if anyone can take a look at the print files tomorrow, I'd really appreciate it. Happy to swap favours later.
Hey Maya, I can take a look at the print files tomorrow. I'll be in around 9:30 after the ride, so I can start after that. Can you drop the folder link here so I've got it first thing?
Thanks Tom, that's a big help. I'll drop the folder link here in a sec. Enjoy the ride tomorrow.
[link: shared folder with the cheese rebrand print files]
Thanks Tom, that's sorted. Maya, I'll still try to do the preflight check tomorrow evening once I'm home, so send me anything that's left then.
Thanks Sam, that's great. I'll send anything left over once I've wrapped up tomorrow. Appreciate you both.
Sounds good, Maya. I'll keep an eye out tomorrow evening. Hope the cheese client behaves.
Ha, fingers crossed. Thanks Sam. Night all.

turns.text: Hey all, quick one: anyone up for a coffee before Monday? I've got the letterpress course Wednesday, so I'm shattered and ink-handed, but Sunday evening's free.

Hi Tom! I'd love to, but I'm buried this week. The cheese client moved their deadline to Friday, and I'm also trying to sort seating charts for my sister's wedding. Could we do a quick call tomorrow lunchtime instead? I can probably spare 30 minutes then.
Sunday's tricky for me too, I'm between the studio and Frenchay this week. Tomorrow lunchtime works for a call if Tom's up for it, Maya, and I can join for a bit.
Tom, I'm free Sunday evening if you still want a coffee, but I'm also in for the lunchtime call tomorrow. I'm happy either way.

Sounds good. Jo, I'll take you up on coffee tonight if you're still around, and I'm in for the lunchtime call tomorrow too. Maya, good luck with the cheese client and the seating charts. Sam, see you on the call if you can make it.
Sounds good, Tom. I'm around tonight, so where should we meet? There's a café on Bedminster Parade that stays open late, or I can come to you if you'd rather not go out in the cold.

Bedminster Parade works, Jo. I'm in Keynsham, so it's a bit of a trek for me, but I'd rather get out than sit in with ink on my hands. Could you do 21:30? If that's too late, say so and I'll sort something earlier.
21:30 is fine, Tom. I'll see you at the café on Bedminster Parade. Let me know if the bus is running late and I'll wait.

Sounds great, you two. Tom, I hope the coffee's a good way to decompress after the course. Sam, lunchtime call tomorrow works for me. I'll be in the middle of the cheese rebrand, so I might only be there for the first bit, but I'll join. Good luck with the Frenchay stuff this week.

privateLines.Maya: You commute from Bedminster across the river to the studio, and this week you're juggling a pitch for a regional brewery alongside your father's move into a care home in Weston-super-Mare, which you visit on Sundays.
privateLines.Tom: You're the studio's only illustrator who still draws by hand, and this week you're finishing a children's book cover while your flatmate in Easton keeps hosting loud rehearsals for a community brass band in the living room.

turns.text: Just back from Weston. Is anyone around? That Friday deadline for the brewery is going to be tight, so I'm planning to start on the pitch first thing tomorrow. Shout if you want to split it up.

Hey, I'm around. Still finishing the kids' book cover, so I can't take on much before Wednesday. I can do the illustrative bits of the pitch once the cover's off my desk, or I can take a look at the concepts if you send them over. Happy to split it however works for you and Jo.

Hey, I'm around! I'm still getting to grips with the studio software, so I'd be slower on the layouts. I could take the brewery research and a first draft of the pitch deck copy, or help with exports and file prep once the concepts are sorted. Maya, what do you think? And Jo, are you free to take the concepts?

Hi all! I can't take the concepts properly. Mornings are my towpath runs and I'm wiped out by mid-morning, and I've got the month-end invoicing to get through this week. Maya, if you're leading the concepts, I can do a quick review after lunch on Monday and then handle the brewery quote and invoice setup so it's ready for the pitch. Sam, the file prep and exports could work for you once the concepts are settled. Does that fit?

Yes, that works for me. I'll take the file prep and exports once the concepts are settled, and I'll ask Maya or Tom if I get stuck on the software. Maya, if you send over the concepts, I can start on the research in the meantime.

Sounds good, Jo. You take a review after lunch Monday plus the brewery quote and invoice setup, and I'll lead the concepts. Sam, file prep and exports once the concepts are settled. Tom, the illustrative bits after your cover. I'll send the concepts over tomorrow morning.
Sounds good, Maya. I'll do the Monday review after lunch plus the brewery quote and invoice setup. Sam, thanks for the file prep and exports.
Sounds good, thanks all. I'll hold off on the exports until Maya's concepts are ready, and I'll let you know if I need help with the software.

turns.text: Hey both, I'm back from Weston. Dad's settled in OK, but I'm wiped. Can we look at the brewery pitch tomorrow before stand-up? Client wants it Friday now, so I'd like to split the work early.

Glad your dad's settled, Maya. Sounds like a long day. Yes to tomorrow before stand-up. I can do 9:00 if that suits. I'll bring my rough thumbnails for the brewery pitch, though I'm still on the children's cover until mid-afternoon, so I may be a bit distracted. Happy to take the illustration side if you split it that way. Get some rest tonight.

Thanks Tom, 9:00 works for me. Yes, let's split it so you take illustration and I take layout and copy. Could you send your thumbnails tonight if you get a chance? That way I can look before we meet. Night x

Night Maya, sleep well. Sorry about your dad. Since you've split it, I'll take the colour and type options so they're ready for Friday, and I'll check with Tom if he wants a hand with the illustrations. See you at 9:00.
Sounds good. I'll take costings and timeline for the brewery, and I'll check the invoicing terms before we meet. Night, Maya. See you both at 9.
Thanks both, that's a good split. Sam, colour and type sounds right. Jo, costings and timeline will help a lot with Friday. See you at 9. Night all x

Night Maya. The thumbnails are still pencil in my sketchbook and I haven't scanned them yet. I'll send photos before 9:00 tomorrow so you can look first. Sam, I'd take a hand with the illustrations if it's free, so thanks for offering. See you all at 9.
Night all. Tom, I'm on colour and type for now, but I can give you a hand with the illustrations once those are done. Send your photos over when you're ready and I'll have a look.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Morning all. I'm on the towpath now, so I'll be quick. Sam, thanks for offering to help Tom. I'll have the costings and timeline ready for 9, though the two blank weeks in the timeline are still open, so I'll fill those in when I'm back.
Morning both. Jo, thanks for getting the costings done. I'm on the way in from Bedminster now, so I'll see you at 9. Tom, if your photos come through before then, I'll have a look on the train.
Morning all. Maya, I'll send the thumbnail photos within the hour, before 9:00. Sam, thanks, I'll take you up on that once the cover's done. Jo, sounds good.
Morning Tom, thanks. I'll look at the photos as soon as they land and come in with notes ready for 9. Jo, if you can get those two timeline weeks filled in before we meet, that would help a lot.
Will do, Maya. Photos coming before 9:00.
Thanks Tom. See you at 9.
Will do, Maya. I'll fill in the two timeline weeks before 9 and have them ready for you to check. I'll also check the invoicing clause with the brewery's accounts contact this morning.
Brilliant, thanks Jo. Checking the invoicing clause with their accounts contact is a good call. See you at 9.
Morning all. I'm still behind on the brewery thumbnails, so I'll send the photos as soon as they're scanned, before 9:00. See you there.
Morning Tom. No rush on the photos, we'll go through what's there at 9 and you can send the rest after. See you in a few minutes.
Thanks Maya, that helps. I'll send what I have before we start and the rest after. See you in a few minutes.
Thanks Tom. We're a bit late starting, so I'll see you in the meeting room in a couple of minutes.
Morning all, I'm on my way up now. Tom, if you can send what you have, I'll have a look before we start.
Morning Sam. I haven't scanned the thumbnails yet, so I'll bring the sketchbook up and we can go through them in the meeting.
Sounds good, Tom. Bring the sketchbook and we'll go through them together. I'll be there in a minute.
Thanks both. Tom, bring the sketchbook and we'll go through them together. I'm in the meeting room now, so I'll start the layout notes while you sort yourself out.
Sorry, both. I'm still on the children's cover and I'm running behind. I'll bring the sketchbook to the meeting room now. The thumbnails aren't scanned, so I'll go through them by hand with you.
Thanks Tom, no need to apologise. Bring the sketchbook and we'll go through it by hand. Sam, are you still around? I'll pull the layout notes together so we're not starting from scratch on Tuesday.

Thanks, Maya. I should be straight with you: I'm not in the meeting room, and I've been behind since this morning. I haven't scanned the brewery thumbnails, so I can't send them tonight either. I'll scan them and send them to you and Sam first thing tomorrow, before stand-up. Sorry for the mixed messages.

Thanks for being straight with me, Tom. Tomorrow before stand-up is fine. Sam, can you check the deadline with the client, since Friday is now the real target and we've lost a day? I'll start on the layout notes tonight so we have something to work from.

Thanks, Tom, I appreciate you being straight about it. Maya, I'll check the deadline with the client tomorrow morning and let you know what they say. I'm still on colour and type, so I'll get those to a state we can show before stand-up.

Thanks, Tom. Tomorrow before stand-up works. Sam, thanks for checking the deadline. Maya, I still need to fill in the two blank timeline weeks and confirm the invoicing clause with the brewery's accounts contact. I'll finish the timeline tonight and send it to you both before stand-up.

Thanks both. Jo, that's great, and if the invoicing clause needs a decision, flag it to me before stand-up. Sam, let me know what the client says tomorrow. I'll start the layout notes tonight and keep them short, since I'm running on empty.
(It's now Tue 24 Nov.)

Morning all. Maya, I didn't finish the timeline last night, so it's still got the two blank weeks. I'll fill those in on the towpath run this morning and send it before stand-up. The invoicing clause is still open too, so I'll flag it to you as soon as I've heard back from the brewery's accounts contact.
Morning Jo, thanks for flagging it. Send the timeline when you can, and let me know as soon as the accounts contact replies. See you at 9.
Will do, Maya. See you at 9.
Morning all. Maya, I'm sorry I've been slow on this. I'll scan the brewery thumbnails and send them to you and Sam before stand-up, and I'll say so here as soon as they're sent.
Morning all. Maya, I'm checking the deadline with the client now and will report back before stand-up. Tom, thanks for sending the thumbnails when they're ready.
Morning Sam. Scanning them now, I'll send them before stand-up.
Thanks all. Tom, scanning now is great. Sam, let me know what the client says. See you at 9.

Maya, I'm sorry, I haven't checked with the client yet. I said I would first thing and I didn't, so I don't have an answer on the deadline. I'll contact them now and message you as soon as I hear back. If it's easier, I can also send you the sketched-out colour and type options so you have something to show whatever they say.
Thanks for being upfront, Sam. Yes please, send the colour and type options when you can. Ring the client if you can, since Friday is the deadline we're working to until they say otherwise.

Maya, I still haven't sent the timeline or flagged the invoicing clause, even though I said I would before stand-up. I'll get both to you this afternoon, and I'll ask the brewery's accounts contact about the clause today.

Thanks Jo, I appreciate you being honest about it. Please send the timeline this afternoon if you can, and flag the invoicing clause as soon as you have an answer. Friday's still the target, so I'll plan around that until we hear otherwise.

Maya, Sam, Jo, I owe you an honest update. I still haven't sent the brewery thumbnails, and I said "scanning now" this morning when I hadn't started. I'm sorry for the run-around. I'll take phone photos of the sketchbook and send them here by 15:00 today, even if they're rough. Scanning can wait.
Thanks for owning it, Tom. Phone photos by 15:00 is perfect, rough is fine. I'll look as soon as they land and start on the layout from there.
Thanks, Maya. I'll send the photos by 15:00.

Maya, I still haven't rung the client, and I haven't got the colour and type options into a shareable state yet. I'm sorry, I should have done the call first thing as I said. I'm ringing them now and will message you the answer straight after. I'll send the colour and type options tonight, even if they're rough, so you have something to look at before 9:00.

Sam, thanks for being straight about the client call. I missed my own 15:00 deadline for the photos too, and I haven't sent them yet. I'll take them as soon as the children's cover is off the board, and send them here by 19:00 tonight at the latest.

Thanks, both. I also missed my own deadline. I still haven't sent the timeline or flagged the invoicing clause, and I said I would this afternoon. I'll send the timeline tonight, and I'll message you about the clause as soon as the brewery's accounts contact replies.

Thanks all, I know it's been a slog. Sam, Tom and Jo, I'm working to Friday until the client tells us otherwise. Please send what you have tonight, even rough. Tom, 19:00 for the photos is fine. Jo, the timeline tonight, and flag the clause as soon as you hear. I'll pull the layout notes together from whatever lands and keep them short. See you at 9.

Maya, I'm at 19:26 and still haven't sent the photos. I'm sorry. The cover is taking longer than I planned. I'll send the sketchbook photos within the next 30 minutes, and if that slips again I'll say so here straight away rather than go quiet.
Thanks Tom, I appreciate you telling us straight. Send whatever you've got in 30 minutes, even if it's rough, and I'll work from it tonight. If it slips again, just say so here.
Will do, Maya. Photos within 30 minutes.

Maya, I still haven't rung the client, and I'm not going to pretend I have. I've let you down twice today by saying I'd do something and not doing it. I'll ring the client first thing tomorrow before stand-up and message you the answer straight after. I'll also send you the colour and type options tonight, rough or not, so you have something to work from.

Thanks for being straight with me, Sam. Ring the client first thing if you can, and send the colour and type options tonight, rough is fine. Tom, I'm still waiting on your photos. Jo, the timeline's still outstanding too, so please send that as soon as you can. I'm working to Friday until the client says otherwise.

Maya, you're right to chase me. I still haven't sent the photos, and I said within 30 minutes at 19:32. I'm sorry. I'll send them within the next 20 minutes, and if I miss that, I'll tell you here straight away.

Maya, I haven't sent the colour and type options yet, and I should have done that before now. Here's a rough version you can look at tonight:

Palette: deep slate (#2B3A42), warm ochre (#D9A441), off-white (#F4EFE6), and a muted sage accent (#8FA58A).
Type: a bold condensed sans for headlines paired with a humanist serif for body copy. I'm still testing which pairing reads best on the label, so treat this as a starting point.
I'll ring the client first thing tomorrow before stand-up and message you the answer straight after.

Maya, Sam, I missed the 20-minute window I gave at 20:39, and I still haven't sent the photos. That's three promised times now, and I'm sorry. I'll send whatever I have of the sketchbook before 9:00 tomorrow, rough or not. If the cover is still eating my time in the morning, I'll say so here before stand-up.

Thanks Sam, the palette and type notes are useful, I'll work from them tonight. Tom, I'd rather have rough photos now than a neat set tomorrow, so if you can send whatever you've got before you go to bed, that helps most. Otherwise I'll see you at 9 and we'll go through the sketchbook by hand. Jo, I'm still waiting on the timeline.

Maya, I'm sorry. I haven't sent the photos, and I'm not going to promise another time I might miss. You'll have them by 9:00 tomorrow, or I'll tell you here before then if that changes. If we go through the sketchbook by hand at 9, that's fine by me.

Maya, I still haven't sent the timeline, and I said tonight. I can't finish the two blank weeks tonight. I'll send you the timeline by 9:00 tomorrow, with those weeks clearly marked as open if they're still empty, and I'll flag the invoicing clause as soon as the brewery replies.
(It's now Wed 25 Nov.)

Morning both. Tom, going through the sketchbook by hand at 9 is fine. Jo, thanks for being straight. Mark the two weeks as open if they're still blank, and let's work round them. Sam's still ringing the client before stand-up, so I'll hold Friday as the target until we hear otherwise.
Morning, Maya. I'll mark the two blank weeks as open on the timeline and send it to you before 9. I'll also flag the invoicing clause as soon as the brewery replies.
Morning all. Maya, going through the sketchbook by hand at 9 works. I'll bring it, and I'll say here before 9 if the cover is still blocking me.
Morning all. Maya, I'm ringing the client now before stand-up and will message you the answer straight after. I'll see you at 9.
Morning Sam. Thanks for ringing them. I'll see everyone at 9 with the sketchbook.
Morning all. Thanks Sam for ringing the client. Tom, sketchbook at 9 is perfect. Jo, mark those weeks open if they're still blank. See you at 9.

Maya, the 9:00 meeting has already passed, and I still haven't sent the timeline. I'm sorry. I've missed every time I've given you, so I won't give you another one. I'll send the timeline with the two open weeks marked as soon as it's done, and I'll tell you here when it's sent.

Maya, Jo, I missed the 9:00 meeting too, and I still haven't sent the sketchbook photos. I've let the whole group down on this. I'm going to finish the cover this afternoon and send the photos as soon as they're taken, with no more times from me. If the cover ends up blocking me again, I'll say so here straight away.

Maya, Jo, Tom, I need to correct something. I said I was ringing the client this morning, but I haven't spoken to them and I don't have an answer on the deadline. Thanks for the thanks, but I didn't earn it. I'll call them this afternoon and post the outcome here, whatever it is. Until then, Friday is still the working target.
Thanks for correcting that, Sam. Maya, I'm sorry too. I still haven't sent the sketchbook photos, and I'm not promising a time again. I'll post them here as soon as they're taken.
Thanks for correcting that, Sam. Maya, I still haven't sent the timeline, and I'll post here as soon as it's done.

Thanks, all. I'd rather hear "not yet" than another promise, so let's go by what's actually done. Tom, post the photos as soon as they're taken, even if they're rough. Jo, same for the timeline. Sam, let us know what the client says when you've called. I'm working to Friday until we hear otherwise, and I'll start the layout from whatever lands.
Maya, fair enough. Going by what's done: I haven't sent the photos yet. The cover is still on the board, and I'll post the sketchbook photos here as soon as they're taken, rough or not.

Maya, I haven't spoken to the client yet, so there's no answer on the deadline. I'll ring them this evening, and I'll post what they say here, or say here that I couldn't get through. Until then I'm treating Friday as the target. I'm also sending the colour and type options as a file now, so you have the current version to work from.
[file: brewery-colour-and-type-options-v2.pdf]
Thanks, Sam. I've got the file. Friday's still the target until you've spoken to the client, so please post the outcome here either way.

brief: This is a group chat on your phone with Maya, Tom and Jo. You work together at a small design studio. You all live in Bristol, England, and know each other as colleagues at a small design studio in Stokes Croft, where you have worked side by side for about four years.
topic: A client has just moved a deadline up to Friday.

privateLines.Maya: You are renting a flat above a launderette in Bedminster with a leaky radiator, and this week you are also covering the studio's accounts while the office manager is off sick.
privateLines.Tom: You are the studio's only freelance-turned-permanent illustrator, working from a shared garden shed in Totterdown, and this week you are finishing a children's book cover series for a publisher in Bath.
privateLines.Jo: You have just moved back to Bristol from Leeds to be near your aging parents in Fishponds, so you are commuting to the studio by bike and still unpacking boxes in the evenings.
privateLines.Sam: You are the studio's newest hire, fresh out of a design course at UWE, living in a shared house in Easton with three flatmates, and this week you are trying to get your first solo project signed off by the director.

turns.text: Hey both! Quick one: the client's moved the deadline to Friday, so I think we need a proper plan. Can one of you look at the file list tomorrow morning? I'm doing the accounts this week too, so I'm a bit stretched.

Hey Maya, I can take the file list tomorrow morning. I'll go through it first thing and flag anything missing or out of order before we plan the rest. Want me to put together a rough checklist for Friday too?

Thanks Sam, that's brilliant. Yes please on the checklist. Anything you can put together tonight or first thing would be a big help. I'll sort out the accounts stuff so it doesn't clash with Friday. Shall we have a quick call at lunch tomorrow to check where we are?

Lunch call works for me. I'm in the shed tomorrow finishing the last two covers for Bath, so I'll have a clearer idea of where they stand by then. I'll send Sam my list of open files tonight so the checklist covers them too.

Thanks both. Lunch call works for me. Tom, your open files list would be really useful, so I'll build the checklist from it once it lands. I'll have a draft ready by lunch so we've got something concrete to go through on the call.

Brilliant, thanks both. Tom, the open files list tonight would help a lot. Sam, a draft by lunch is perfect. I'll bring the accounts bits I need you to know about, so we're not all guessing on Friday. See you at lunch.
Sorry, I haven't pulled the list together yet. I'll post it first thing tomorrow, before the call, so Sam has it for the draft. I'll note which covers are done and which are still open.
No worries, Tom. First thing tomorrow is fine. If you can, flag anything that's blocking, so Sam knows what to prioritise. Night all.
Night Maya. Tom, first thing tomorrow is fine, and flagging blockers is a good idea. I'll start on the checklist with what we already know and fold in your list when it lands.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)

Morning all. Sam, thanks for starting the checklist. Tom, whenever your list lands, that's great. I'm up early with a cold flat and the radiator knocking, so I'm going to crack on with the accounts before the call. I'll bring what I've got to lunch.
Morning Maya, hope the radiator sorts itself out. Sounds good. I'm on the file list now and will have the checklist draft ready for lunch.
Thanks Sam, that's great. Fingers crossed for the radiator too. I'm off to chase those supplier invoices now, and I'll see you both at lunch.
Morning both. Here's my open files list for the Bath series:
[file: Bath_covers_open_files.txt]

Cover 1 is done and final. Cover 2 is still open: the title lettering needs redoing, and I'm starting on that from the shed this morning. The lettering is the only blocker I know of, and it should be finished before lunch. I'll confirm once it's done so Sam can update the checklist.

Thanks Tom, that's really helpful. Cover 1 done and Cover 2 only blocked on the lettering is a clear picture. Let us know when the lettering's finished. Sam, that should give you what you need for the checklist. See you both at lunch.
Will do. Lettering's underway in the shed, and I'll post here once it's done.
Brilliant, thanks Tom. Good luck with the lettering. I'll be at my desk with the invoices, and see you both at lunch.
Thanks Maya. I'll let you know when the lettering's done.
Sounds good, Tom. Thanks for the update. See you at lunch.

Thanks Tom, that's clear. Cover 1 is done and Cover 2 is only waiting on the lettering. I'll update the checklist to match and add a line for the two folders I couldn't place in the file list, so we can check with you whether they're missing or just named differently. I'll have the draft ready for lunch.
Thanks Sam, that's a good catch on the two folders. I'll check the accounts side while you do that, and we'll go through it all at lunch.

Thanks both. I don't have the two folders Sam couldn't place, so I'll check them against the list when I'm back at the laptop and tell you what I find. The lettering's still in progress, so I'll update the group once it's finished.
Thanks Tom. Lunch call's now or soon, so let's pick the two folders up there if they're still unclear. I'll share the accounts status at the call too.

Sorry, I've been heads-down on the lettering and missed the call window. I'll look at the two folders now and post what I find here. If the lettering's still open when you finish the call, I'll give you a status update then.

No worries Tom, thanks for the update. Sam, if you're free, shall we run through the checklist and the accounts status now without waiting on the folders? I'll flag the invoices I still need to chase so we can plan around them.

Go ahead without me on the folders. I haven't checked them yet and can't say whether they're missing or just named differently. The lettering on Cover 2 is still in progress, so I'll post here as soon as it's done and I've looked at the folders.

Thanks Tom, understood. Sam, shall we go ahead with the checklist and accounts status now? I'll flag the supplier invoices I still need to chase, and we can plan Friday around the two folders and Cover 2 once Tom's updated us.

Checklist so far, with the two folders still open until Tom has checked them:

- Cover 1: done and final
- Cover 2: title lettering in progress (Tom, shed)
- Two folders Sam couldn't place: Tom to check
- Supplier invoices: Maya chasing, to be marked against Friday
- Deadline: Friday, client has moved it
Maya, send over the invoices you're chasing and I'll slot them in.

Thanks Sam, that checklist is spot on. I haven't actually opened the supplier invoices yet, so I can't send a list of what's outstanding until I've been through them. I'll get to them this afternoon and send you the list once I know what's owed and what's due before Friday. Sorry for the delay on that.
I'm still on the Cover 2 lettering and haven't checked the two folders yet, so I'll post an update once I've done both.
Thanks Tom, no rush. Just post when you've got both sorted. I'm still working through the invoices, so I'll send Sam the list once I've got through them.
(It's now Tue 24 Nov.)
Morning all. I'm still on Cover 2's lettering in the shed and haven't checked the two folders yet. I'll post here when both are done, and I'll be honest about where things stand if they slip again.
Morning Tom, thanks for being straight with us. Keep going on the lettering, and post when you've had a look at the folders. Sam, I'll have the invoice list for you this morning.

Morning both. Thanks Tom, straight answers help. Maya, the invoice list this morning is perfect. Once it lands I'll mark what's due before Friday against the checklist. Still open: Cover 2 lettering and the two folders, with Tom to update.
Morning Sam. I'm on the invoices now and will send you the list before lunch, with what's owed and what's due before Friday. Thanks for keeping the checklist moving.
Thanks Maya, I'll wait for the list before lunch and mark it against Friday. See you at lunch.
Thanks Sam. I'm on it now and will send the list before lunch. See you then.
Morning. Still on Cover 2's lettering and haven't looked at the two folders yet, so both are open. I'll post the moment either is done.
Thanks Tom, that's clear. Both still open, I'll keep the checklist as it is until you post.
Thanks both. Sam, I still owe you the invoice list before lunch, and I'm running late on it. I'll send it within the hour, and I'll flag anything due before Friday first.
No problem Maya, take the time you need. Send the list when it's ready and I'll mark what's due before Friday. Tom, post when the lettering or the folders are sorted.
Still on Cover 2's lettering, and I haven't checked the two folders yet. Both are still open. I'll post as soon as each one is done.
Thanks Tom, both still open is clear. Sam, I'm still working through the invoices, so I'll send the list by 2pm at the latest, with anything due before Friday flagged first.
Thanks both. Maya, 2pm works. I'll hold the invoice side of the checklist until your list arrives. Tom, post when the lettering or the folders are done.
Thanks Sam, 2pm it is. I'll get the invoice list to you by then.
(It's now Wed 25 Nov.)

Morning all. Cover 2's lettering is still open and I haven't checked the two folders yet. I'm in the shed on it now and will post here when each is done. I know I've been slow on this, and I'm sorry it's left you working around me.

Morning Tom, no need to apologise. It's clear where things stand, and we'll plan around it. Sam, I know I missed the 2pm list yesterday, and I'm sorry about that. I'll get the invoice list to you this morning, with anything due before Friday at the top.
Morning Maya, thanks. I'm still on Cover 2's lettering. The two folders are unchecked, and I'll post here when each one is done.
Thanks Tom, that's clear. Sam, I'm on the invoice list now and will send it this morning, with the Friday items at the top.

Morning both. Thanks Tom, that's clear. Maya, no worries about yesterday, the Friday items at the top will help. Once the invoice list lands I'll mark it against the checklist. Still open: Cover 2 lettering and the two folders.
Thanks Sam, really appreciate your patience. I'm working through the invoices now and will send the list shortly, with the Friday items first.
Still on Cover 2's lettering, and the two folders are unchecked. I'll post here as soon as either is done.

Thanks Tom. Sam, I owe you the invoice list and I've missed every time I said I'd send it, so I'm sorry. I'll send tonight what I've confirmed so far, with Friday items at the top and anything I haven't checked marked as unchecked, so you're not waiting on me again.

Thanks Maya, that's a fair plan. Send what you've confirmed tonight with the Friday items first, and mark the rest as unchecked. I'll work from that and keep the checklist open until you've finished the rest. Tom, still waiting on the lettering and folders.
Thanks Sam. I'll send the confirmed invoices tonight, Friday items first, with the rest marked unchecked.

brief: This is a group chat on your phone with Maya, Jo and Sam. You work together at a small design studio. You all live in Bristol, England, and know each other as colleagues at a small design studio in Stokes Croft, where you have worked side by side for about four years.
topic: A client has just moved a deadline up to Friday.

privateLines.Maya: You are renting a flat above a launderette in Bedminster with a leaky radiator, and this week you are also covering the studio's accounts while the office manager is off sick.
privateLines.Tom: You are the studio's only freelance-turned-permanent illustrator, working from a shared garden shed in Totterdown, and this week you are finishing a children's book cover series for a publisher in Bath.
privateLines.Jo: You have just moved back to Bristol from Leeds to be near your aging parents in Fishponds, so you are commuting to the studio by bike and still unpacking boxes in the evenings.
privateLines.Sam: You are the studio's newest hire, fresh out of a design course at UWE, living in a shared house in Easton with three flatmates, and this week you are trying to get your first solo project signed off by the director.

turns.text: Hey all, anyone else dreading the Friday deadline the client just pushed through? I've got the accounts to sort this week too, so I'm going to be a bit scarce. Tom, Jo, Sam, how are you all holding up?

Hey Maya, sorry the deadline's landed on you with the accounts too. I'm alright, though the cover series is eating my weekend. Two of the three are roughly done and the last one's fighting me. Shout if you need a hand with anything on your end. I can take a look at the accounts bits you don't have time for.

Thanks Tom, that's really kind. The accounts are mostly reconciling and chasing invoices, so I'll send you anything that's tripping me up. I'll take you up on that. Good luck with the last cover, hope it stops fighting you soon.

Hey Maya, sorry the deadline's landed on you too. I'm alright, just tight. My first solo project needs the director's sign-off before Friday and I'm still tweaking the layout, so I'm probably going to be glued to my laptop for a bit. Tom, thanks for offering to help Maya, that's really decent of you. Good luck with the last cover.
Thanks Sam, good luck with the sign-off. Sounds like we're all buried this week. Tom, I'll ping you if the accounts get messy.
Thanks Maya. Yeah, it's a proper crunch week for all of us. Ping me if you need anything from the studio side, like files or exports, and I'll help where I can.
Thanks Sam, I'll keep that in mind. Hope the layout comes together without too much fuss.
Thanks Maya, appreciated. Hope the accounts don't eat the whole week.

Sorry, I've been quiet. I'm alright. Still half unpacked from the move back, so evenings are boxes and the bike commute is taking some getting used to. Good luck with the accounts, Maya, and with the sign-off, Sam.

Welcome back to Bristol, Jo, and good luck with the boxes. The bike commute gets easier once the hills stop feeling personal. If you want a hand unpacking at some point, say so, though the shed's not much better, so you'd be helping me hide from my cover too.
Thanks Tom, that's kind. The hills are definitely personal so far. I'll take you up on the unpacking offer once the cover's done. Hopefully it stops fighting you soon.
Thanks Jo, good to have you back in the chat. Settle in when you can, and the hills will get easier. Thanks Sam, I'm trying not to let the accounts eat the week.
Welcome back, Jo! Hope the boxes don't take over the whole week. Hills are rough on the bike, but you'll get used to them. Maya, you've got this, one reconciliation at a time.
Thanks Sam! Hoping the boxes stay in their corner. Good luck with the layout, and Maya, one reconciliation at a time sounds right.
Thanks both, that's a good way to put it. I'll get back to the spreadsheet now. Good luck with the layout, Sam, and enjoy the boxes, Jo.
(It's now Mon 23 Nov.)
Thanks both! Good luck with the spreadsheet, Maya. Jo, may the boxes stay in their corner.
Ha, thanks Sam. Off to the studio now, wish me luck with the reconciliation.
Good luck, Maya! Hope the reconciliation behaves itself.
Thanks Jo! Fingers crossed it behaves. I'll shout if it doesn't.
Good luck, Maya! Hope it behaves. Shout if you get stuck and I'll look when I'm at the studio.
Thanks Sam, that's kind. I'll shout if I get stuck. Right now I'm in the spreadsheet with a cold cup of tea.
Cold tea and a spreadsheet is a rough combo, Maya. Hope the numbers start cooperating soon.
Ha, it really is. Making a fresh cup now. Numbers, behave.
Ha, a fresh cup is the right call, Maya. Numbers, behave!
Ha, thanks Sam. Tea's made, numbers still misbehaving. Going back in.
